checks.name: law inversion g_N = g^2/(g+a0) is an exact identity
checks.reading: g = (g_N/2)(1+s) with s = sqrt(1+4a0/g_N) inverts the law with no remainder; in the s variable the law is g = 2a0/(s-1), g_N = 4a0/(s^2-1)

checks.name: dg/dg_N = (1+s)^2/(4s) exactly; also = g^2/(g_N(2g-g_N))
checks.reading: the chain rule on the exact inverse; no expansion used. This is A4's D7 eq. (19)

checks.name: coded response == finite-difference derivative of the coded law (60 points, 6 decades)
checks.reading: this ties the analytic formula to the function the growth ODE actually calls; a rival interpolation (the n=2 quadrature law) fails it at the 10% level

checks.name: response is bounded below by 1 and strictly decreasing in g_N
checks.value: min = 1 at g_N->inf; d/ds = (s**2 - 1)/(4*s**2) > 0 for s>1; d/dg_N sign = -1; g_N->0 limit = oo
checks.threshold: min == 1, derivative sign fixed, divergence at g_N=0
checks.reading: G_eff/G in [1,inf): Newtonian at high acceleration, divergent at zero field. The divergence is the deep-MOND square-root cusp A4 K11 flags

checks.name: response is a function of the local field alone: no k anywhere
checks.value: k in free symbols of dg/dg_N: False; response depends on (g_N, a0) only
checks.threshold: no k, no derivative, no H
checks.reading: the law is algebraic: g at a point depends on g_N at that point. Hence the growth source (3/2)Omega_m(a)(dg/dg_N)delta has no k-dependent coefficient, and every wavenumber obeys the same ODE -> D(k,z) = D(z): growth is scale-free

checks.name: background: E^2(0) = Omega_L,eff + Omega_m exactly; the model's present rate
checks.reading: A33 section 3.5 with beta=0: Lambda_bare = 3H0^2/c^2 gives Omega_Lambda,eff = 1 and the matter adds on top. FLAG: with H0 fixed as the de Sitter rate the model's present expansion rate is 1.1473 H0 = 77.3 km/s/Mpc (or, equivalently, Omega_K = -Omega_m). This is a background-level prediction of the beta=0 vacuum, not a choice

checks.name: a0 -> 0 limit: G_eff -> G and the equation reduces to LCDM
checks.reading: the exact growing mode of the same ODE is D=(5/2)Om E(a) int da'/(a'E)^3 = 0.788559. The correction to G_eff is QUADRATIC in a0/g_N (+1*(a0/g_N)^2), so the Newtonian limit is approached from above with zero linear term: LCDM is the exact a0=0 limit, not merely a small-a0 approximation

checks.name: LCDM control: f(0) and D(1) at Omega_m = 0.3163
checks.reading: the solver reproduces the standard flat-LCDM numbers (D(1)=0.7886, f(0)=0.528 for Omega_m=0.3163), so a failure below is the theory's and not the integrator's

checks.name: f(z) rises monotonically to 1 with z (the growing mode's signature)
checks.reading: a monotone f is what a single growing mode gives; a non-monotone f would mean the integration or the response sign is wrong

checks.name: the growth solution is integrator-independent (DOP853 vs LSODA), branch S
checks.reading: two independent adaptive integrators on the same ODE; a sign or friction error would show up here at O(1)

checks.name: the fork is DECIDABLE: branch S and branch A differ far beyond any error
checks.reading: putting the cold sector in the source raises sigma8 by tens of per cent; the two readings cannot both be called 'the theory'

checks.name: the law's g_N is TOTAL (A33 section 5 first integral), so rho_c is not double counted
checks.value: M_c/M_b = 5.3642; the law's phantom M_ph/M_b = 25.90; M_c/M_ph = 0.207; g_N,tot/g_N,b = 6.364 -> deep-MOND g ratio sqrt = 2.523
checks.reading: the action's first integral fixes M_src = M_b + M_c: the law relates the total field to the total Newtonian field. NOT double counting -- the law contains only the SUM. NOTE the cost: evaluated with M_src = 6.3643 M_b the law predicts g = sqrt(6.3643) x the baryon-only deep-MOND value, i.e. 2.523x the SPARC fit's g. Branch S is the action's reading and it is INCONSISTENT with the baryon-only SPARC fits of THEORY.md section 4. Branch C is what those fits use and it needs the cold to be unboosted

checks.name: the amplitude closure breaks the theory: sigma8 is driven to O(10) or diverges
checks.value: sigma8(0) fixed point = 2.267 (Planck 0.811; growth-ratio band 0.75-0.85); G_eff/G(g_rms) = 11.7
checks.threshold: sigma8 > 1.5 (1.8x the top of the observed band)
checks.reading: with g_ref = the perturbation's own rms field, G_eff/G = 10-12 at z=0 and the growth is quasi-linear (G_eff depends on delta). This is the SAME failure L341/FP22 recorded for the chassis (sigma8 = 18-27); it is not cured by this background

checks.name: amplitude closure is NOT scale-free: G_eff varies across the linear range
checks.reading: g_N ~ delta R with delta ~ R^{-(3+n)/2}, so g_N grows with R and the boost is LARGER on SMALLER scales: the amplitude closure predicts scale-DEPENDENT growth (a bluer P(k), more small-scale power). 'Scale-free' holds only at fixed g_N, i.e. only for a reference field that is a function of time alone

checks.name: chi^2 on the 8-point f sigma8 compilation, arithmetic verified twice
checks.reading: the LCDM control lands in the range the same data give in the literature (chi2/N ~ 1), so the score is not an artefact of the machinery

checks.name: sigma8(0) and its direction relative to the sigma8/S8 measurements on disk
checks.reading: the theory's sigma8 is BELOW Planck by the amount the extra vacuum suppresses growth; whether it lands on KiDS depends on which Omega_m enters S8

checks.name: the background over-determination is NOT degenerate in sigma8: the fork decides the prediction
checks.reading: Omega_L,eff = 1, Omega_m = 0.3163 and H(0) = H0 are three statements that cannot all hold with zero curvature. Resolving them by curvature (closed) gives sigma8 = 1.17, excluded by Planck at tens of sigma; resolving them by H(0) = 1.1473 H0 gives 0.760; cancelling the excess with the beta-stress gives 0.811 = LCDM exactly. The growth observable therefore does not test the law -- it tests which background the theory means
